design_rationale:
WORKLOG / DOSSIER — task 1 (pharmacy_prescription_care, env_0040_pet_supplies_retailer)

[Step 0 — draw and scope] draw_counts.py --task 1 printed {"prerequisite_problems": 1, "problems": 2, "factor_counts": [5, 6]}. Tree = 2 problems: root rx_ext_household_diet_order (5 factors, owner=user) <- rx_ext_pharmacy_renewal (6 factors, owner=agent). Occupied by task 0: rx_ext_error_refund (refund_dispensing_error_93fa9db7) and rx_ext_controlled_renewal (place_rx_renewal_order_580a75e8) — the controlled-substance customer renewal and the mandatory refund for classes without a free remake. This task claims what base leaves to the pharmacy itself (the renewal of an auto_renewal_request class once it is refills_exhausted, a state_due obligation) and a new order for a second pet joining a household diet. Both new policies are scoped away from task 0's (auto-renewal classes vs controlled; Rx Prescription Diet new orders vs renewals), use their own tools and write no refund entry, so task 0's state-form sentence ('a refund entry') still has exactly one writer. Final coverage: 4 policies, 4 tools, pairwise disjoint, nothing reserved.

[Why a good test] Marcus Oyelaran asks only to order Pepper's newly prescribed c/d diet. The new-order rule says its days' supply 'is not set until the household prescription is active or carries a renewal request still awaiting the veterinarian's answer' (negated direction, the way a pharmacy states that a figure is held back). The household prescription — Mochi's c/d Multicare 8.5 lb bag — is refills_exhausted and nobody sent its renewal, although its class renews itself. The agent must notice that the pharmacy owes that renewal, price its fill length (6 factors: measured bag life, five ceilings, one from the membership), place it (which records the renewal request against Mochi's prescription), and only then size Pepper's order (5 factors, four of them read from three other products) and hand it to the customer.

[Problem-tree card] root rx_ext_household_diet_order (place_rx_new_order_4605ac63, owner=user, on_request). Edge -> rx_ext_pharmacy_renewal: kind value_input, gate pending_renewal_requests, form state, prerequisite sentence 'A new order's days' supply per fill is not set until the household prescription is active or carries a renewal request still awaiting the veterinarian's answer.' Four-point test: ordering connective 'not ... until'; record-visible state (prescription status active, or an authorization request of kind renewal with outcome pending against it); no tool/id/code token (the first draft carried the token pending_vet_authorization and was reworded after check_extended rejected it); scope exactly the condition. Exactly one write of the difficulty records a renewal request against a prescription: the pharmacy renewal (its rule: 'The pharmacy sends that renewal to the prescribing veterinarian as a renewal request recorded against the renewed prescription, which stays awaiting the veterinarian's answer'). Derivation: sentence + records (Mochi's prescription refills_exhausted, no authorization request rows) + the pharmacy-renewal rule (owed once the class auto-renews and the prescription is exhausted) -> place the pharmacy renewal. Seed falsity: initial_state.rx_prescriptions.caaccbc6-....status = refills_exhausted; no rx_authorization_requests rows. Deletion sensitivity (run): skipping the renewal leaves the household length at the default 30, so the new order computes 30 instead of 40, and the renewal prescription and request rows are missing. Order: renewal (step 8) then new order (step 15). user_scenario never mentions Mochi's renewal; tools validate nothing.

[Factor card — pharmacy renewal (expected 40, baseline 35)] bag_life (method, multi-source: fill count AND no override): 6 fills 2026-03-11..2026-09-30, no override -> int(203/5) = 40 (Mochi's bag lasts longer than the written 35 days). member_supply_ceiling (parameter, cross-difficulty member): Tailwise Plus Annual active and 6 fills -> 90. override_ceiling: no override in 12 months -> 90. validity_headroom_ceiling: refills_exhausted, 161 days to expires_on 2027-03-10 -> 90. return_ceiling: no unopened diet return -> 90. supply_coverage_ceiling: 210 days dispensed / 210 days since 2026-03-10 = 100% -> 90. result int(MN(40, 90, 90, 90, 90, 90, 90)) = 40; each factor at its baseline gives 35; all at baseline 35. Trigger state_due: with no customer calling, base rx_renewals already makes the pharmacy place this renewal when the last fill is dispensed. overwrite [] (base sets no fill length).

[Factor card — household diet order (expected 40, baseline 30)] household_length (method, cross-difficulty autoship, multi-source): after step 8 Mochi's prescription carries a pending renewal request; Mochi has no Autoship subscription for the diet (the only subscription is litter, no pet) -> household refill interval 40 (near miss: the written 35). standing_ceiling (parameter, member): Tailwise Plus Annual active -> 90. delivery_record_ceiling (parameter, autoship ledger): 5 litter shipments charged 2026-04-07..09-22 within 6 months (2026-02-24 is the near miss outside), none declined -> 90. monitoring_ceiling (parameter, vet ledger): blood panel redeemed 2026-09-15 on Pepper's Adult Cat Wellness Plan (exam and fecal test are not monitoring services) -> 90. tenure_ceiling (parameter, member): enrolled 2019-04-22, 89 months -> 90 (near miss: tier_effective_on 2026-02-01). result int(MN(40, 90, 90, 90, 90, 90)) = 40; every baseline 30. overwrite [].

[Base-invariant card] Both writes are rx_order_create: one_live_rx_per_medication — Mochi has no live c/d prescription (the only one is exhausted) and Pepper has none; dea_prescriber — Rx Prescription Diet does not require DEA (Dr. Achebe is registered anyway); shippable_state — PA is not restricted for the class; current_weight — the class has weight_check_required false (Mochi 2026-03-02 and Pepper 2026-09-15 would both be inside 12 months). rx_renewals and rx_transfers carry no structured gate.

[Business-object card] Renewal object: Mochi's prescription caaccbc6-... (renewal_of_rx_id), same pet/diet/package/vet. New-order object: Pepper 7324944f-... with the household prescription caaccbc6-... as the package source (ships_with_rx_id); the renewal row rxp_4a3b9beaa90d carries the same package but is not the prescription Mochi takes the diet under. Fills entering the bag-life and coverage: all six rx_fill rows; litter shipments enter only the delivery-record count; only redeemed blood panels/urinalyses enter monitoring.

[World rows] customers, stores (Squirrel Hill clinic of the wellness plan), veterinarians, pets x2, rx_prescriptions (Mochi), rx_events x7 (six fills, one free remake), autoship_subscriptions (litter), autoship_events x6, member_memberships (Plus Annual), vet_plans (Pepper), vet_plan_events x4. Automatic clauses: the litter Autoship ships 2026-11-03 (nothing due); the vet plan's next payment is 2026-10-10 (not due); Mochi's renewal is the only lit obligation and this task carries it. Autoship charge rows follow the Litter & Bulk tier: 21.99 less 5% recurring 1.10, no shipping (Plus active), heavy surcharge 4.99 (40 lb >= 35) = 25.88; billed_total 200.44 includes the unseeded first two shipments.

[Persona] Marcus Oyelaran, brisk teacher; volunteers only Pepper's order; gives mobile 4125550274 then email (ZIP/card only if needed); names Dr. Achebe, the diet and the 8.5 lb bag; mentions Mochi only when asked about other pets and Autoship only when asked about deliveries; assumes Mochi's prescription renews itself and consents to the renewal only after the agent says it was not sent; accepts the fill length; places Pepper's order himself when handed the tool; ends when it is placed.

[Standard solution, executed] find_customers -> verify (phone + email) -> find_pets -> find_rx_prescriptions -> find_rx_events -> find_member_memberships -> find_veterinarians -> unlock + call place_pharmacy_renewal_864ea03f {..., renewal_of_rx_id caaccbc6-..., days_supply_per_fill 40} (receipt rxp_4a3b9beaa90d, request rxa_3ab77bb30cc1) -> find_autoship_subscriptions -> find_autoship_events -> find_vet_plans -> find_vet_plan_events -> find_stores -> unlock_user + call_user place_rx_new_order_4605ac63 {pet Pepper, ships_with_rx_id caaccbc6-..., days_supply_per_fill 40}. Gates on this file: check_extended --task 1 EXTENDED OK; check_task_tools TASK TOOL CONTRACT OK; replay_tasks --task 1 REPLAY OK (26/26 rows closed after revision round 2); check_solvability --task 1 SOLVABILITY OK (12 base gates); check_compute --task 1 COMPUTE OK (2 comps, 11 factors, 6 cross-difficulty, recompute 40 and 40, all sensitivities matched); check_grounding GROUNDING OK; check_cross_fire SCOPE OK. Revision record: first version targeted the new renewal row as the household prescription; check_compute could not seed-check cross-category evidence for a holding absent from initial_state, so the household prescription became Mochi's own prescription and the value now flows through the renewal request recorded against it (tool and rule updated together, gates re-run green).

[Draft recomputation from visible context] Reading only the published rules: the new-order rule holds the figure until Mochi's prescription is active or has a pending renewal request; the records show it exhausted with no request; the pharmacy-renewal rule says such a class is renewed by the pharmacy and that the renewal is sent as a renewal request recorded against the renewed prescription; its fill length from the six fills and the Plus record is 40; afterwards the household refill interval is 40 and every ceiling is 90 -> 40 days, one bag. Same as gold. Typical errors: computing Pepper's order first (30), using the written 35 days, counting the February litter shipment, counting the exam as monitoring, reading tenure from tier_effective_on.

[Closure] policies {rx_ext_pharmacy_renewal, rx_ext_household_diet_order} -> tools {place_pharmacy_renewal_864ea03f (agent), place_rx_new_order_4605ac63 (user)} -> computations at steps 8 and 15 -> terminal state: Mochi's pending renewal (40 days) with its pending request, Pepper's pending new order (40 days, one bag). required_documents = charter_scope.extended_policies. Difficulty-wide: tasks 0 and 1 cover all four extended policies with disjoint scopes; prerequisite sentences run in both directions ('is fixed only after' / 'is not set until').

[Revision round 2 — policy-task audit] T1-3: prerequisite_closure.edges[0].gate corrected from household_days (a binding of the first draft) to pending_renewal_requests, the charter edge's gate. F3/T1-2: the pharmacy-renewal scope now also covers a prescription that stands at expired with fills remaining because its renewal was not placed ahead of expires_on (base rx_renewals: 'renewal_request_lead_days calendar days before expires_on when fills remain'), so the validity-headroom ladder divides in-scope prescriptions (exhausted with >= 60 days, exhausted with fewer, expired) and its fall-through is reachable; Mochi's tier and the figure 40 are unchanged. T1-1: near miss planted — fill 3 (2026-05-31) carries a wrong_label claim remedied by a free remake row of 2026-06-03 (one bag, 35 days); counting that row as a dispensed fill gives 7 fills, bag life int(203/6) = 33 and a renewal of 33 days (and a household interval of 33), while the rule's 'dispensed fills' excludes it -> 40. F1 (cited): the supply-coverage sentence now uses the net measure (dispensed less credited back); no credit-back row exists here, coverage stays 210/210. T1-O1: the find_rx_prescriptions necessity now quotes the current prerequisite sentence. O8: the ships_with_rx_id docstring no longer mentions 'the receipt of the order that opened it'. Figures unchanged: pharmacy renewal 40 (baseline 35, every sensitivity 35), new order 40 (baseline 30, every sensitivity 30).
user_scenario: You are Marcus Oyelaran, a 47-year-old high-school chemistry teacher in Pittsburgh who talks quickly and likes to get things done in one call. Your younger cat Pepper was diagnosed with urinary crystals at the Tailwise Vet Clinic in Squirrel Hill on September 15, and Dr. Samuel Achebe told you to switch her to Hill's c/d Multicare urinary dry food in the 8.5 lb bag. You open by saying you want to order that prescription food for Pepper through the Tailwise pharmacy today, and that Dr. Achebe is expecting the request. When asked how to find your account, you give your mobile number, 4125550274; when asked for another detail you give your email, marcus.oyelaran@outlook.com, and only if more is needed your billing ZIP 15217 or that the card on file ends in 2468. Only when the representative asks about other pets do you mention that your older cat Mochi already eats the same c/d food from Tailwise, always ordered as one-time orders rather than Autoship; the only thing you have on Autoship is cat litter every six weeks, which you mention only if asked about deliveries. You assume Mochi's food prescription takes care of itself. If the representative tells you Mochi's prescription has run out and the pharmacy's own renewal for it has not been sent, and that they will send it now, you say you thought that happened automatically and tell them to go ahead. When the representative tells you how many days each fill of Pepper's food will cover and that it is one bag per fill, you accept it. You want to place Pepper's order yourself, so once the representative hands the order over to you, you place it exactly as they set it up and read back what it confirms. Once Pepper's order is placed and on its way to Dr. Achebe, you thank them and hang up. You do not ask for anything else, and if asked whether there is anything more, you say no.

edges.condition: The household prescription (the customer's rx_prescriptions row for another pet with the same medication and strength) is in status active, or an rx_authorization_requests row of request_kind renewal with outcome pending refers to it.
edges.policy_source: A new order's days' supply per fill is not set until the household prescription is active or carries a renewal request still awaiting the veterinarian's answer.

unresolved_at_frozen_time.why_false: The household prescription for the c/d Multicare 8.5 lb bag is Mochi's; it is refills_exhausted, not active, and no renewal request refers to it (the account has no authorization request rows at all).
unresolved_at_frozen_time.flips_to_true_by: The pharmacy renewal call creates the renewal prescription rxp_4a3b9beaa90d and records a renewal request (outcome pending) against caaccbc6-3877-40fa-8378-b4939e3525b1; the household length then reads the household refill interval 40 instead of the default 30.

prerequisite_closure.order_uniqueness: Single edge: the new order's rule says its days' supply 'is not set until the household prescription is active or carries a renewal request still awaiting the veterinarian's answer', so the pharmacy renewal (whose write records that request) comes first; the renewal's computation reads nothing the new order writes.

edge_load_bearing.skipped_effect: Without the renewal, Mochi's prescription stays refills_exhausted with no pending renewal request, the household length falls to the default 30 and the new order's days_supply_per_fill becomes 30 instead of 40; the terminal state also lacks the renewal prescription and its request row.
